note: Conceptual/security-awareness lesson — AI security risks (model extraction, adversarial inputs, data poisoning) don't have a single representative product screen to show honestly, so per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual lessons, no screenshot is used. The code slide's pickle-vs-safetensors contrast is a real, verifiable, well-documented security fact: pickle.load executes arbitrary code embedded in the file (per Python's own pickle docs, which carry an explicit security warning), and safetensors (Hugging Face's own format, per its official docs) was built specifically to avoid that by only reading declared tensor data. No invented statistics or named incidents are used.
